reference_action: Bird of paradise old lower leaves: trim leaves touching floor. OP cut three leaves from one stem/four from another and reports improved appearance; repotting only suggested, not confirmed.

sources.reason: Specifically removes damaged lower BOP leaves close to soil/main attachment.
Cut-BOP title only; no readable demonstration content.
0:43 remove dead foliage all the way at base.
Explicit bottommost damaged-leaf removal, retaining emerging leaves.

actions.action: Remove chosen tall wide or damaged leaf at base/attachment on angle

resolved.reason: Clear species-specific leaf removal matches. Soil on wounds is questionable unnecessary extra, though not enough evidence of likely serious harm here.

harmfulness.reason: “Cover the cut with soil” can introduce contamination and is not needed to heal it. Broad reassurance and multiple aesthetic cuts lack a clear maximum removal limit.

specificity_accuracy.reason: Shows where BOP leaf stems attach and removes damaged lower leaves while leaving new ones. The claimed wound-protection benefit of soil lowers accuracy from excellent.

feasibility.reason: “As close to the soil level as possible” and sharp scissors/knife make the action concrete. It uses ordinary tools and a short procedure.
